snapshot.title: Theft from a locked shop — Shivaji Market
snapshot.summary: Reported occurrence at Shivaji Market. Theft from a locked shop. Thorough investigation required; the schedule was known in advance, which suggests inside involvement.

fir.narrative: Nitin Bhonsle, Account Cashier, Sunrise Logistics Pvt Ltd withdrew cash ₹418000, mostly in ₹500 denominations, on Monday Morning. While transporting the cash to Sector 9, he, alongwith Mr. Ramzan, was stopped by two armed unknown men around Marol Depot Road. Mr. Ramzan was hit by the gun on head which caused head injury and visible external bleeding. The victims claim it to be a planned robbery by unknown persons.
